barriers.title: Tritium Scarcity
barriers.detail: ~25kg global supply. Lithium blanket breeding unproven at commercial scale.

barriers.title: Materials Degradation
barriers.detail: Neutron bombardment degrades structural components faster than fission. No material validated for full commercial duty cycle. EU €340M research program launched Jan 2026.

barriers.title: Timeline Slippage History
barriers.detail: ITER over $22B and years behind. Fusion timelines have historically slipped by 5-10 years across all major programs.

barriers.title: Net Energy Positive at Grid Scale
barriers.detail: NIF achieved ignition in 2022 but energy output was laser-input dependent. Commercial energy positive remains undemonstrated at utility scale.

milestone_banner.text: On October 2026, General Fusion reported electron temperatures exceeding 1 keV and claimed a 'world first' milestone, while ITER completed delivery of all vacuum vessel sectors needed for core machine assembly.

kstar.name: KSTAR
kstar.description: KSTAR achieved a 48-second plasma hold at 100 million degrees in its upgraded full tungsten divertor environment, continuing progress toward its 300-second target. The facility has surpassed 20,000 total experiments and continues advancing long-pulse plasma operation research.

cfs.name: Commonwealth Fusion
cfs.description: CFS secures $85M for fusion-ready semiconductor development while partnering with Siemens and NVIDIA on AI-powered digital twins for ARC commercial plant. SPARC construction continues toward 2027 first plasma with five peer-reviewed papers validating ARC physics published.

helion.name: Helion Energy
helion.description: Helion quietly shifted its first power timeline in September 2026 while achieving a plasma temperature record. The company raised $465M at a $15.5B valuation in June 2026 and continues advancing toward commercialization with US regulatory licenses cleared.

tae.name: TAE Technologies / TMTG
tae.description: TAE Technologies and Trump Media S-4 registration statement remains under SEC review following September 30, 2026 filing. Target close date of mid-2026 has passed with no announced completion; merger awaiting regulatory clearance.

iter.name: ITER
iter.description: Europe delivers final vacuum vessel sector, completing all major components needed for ITER's core machine assembly. Project reports substantial progress in assembly work with 2027 first plasma target on track.

east.name: EAST / China Program
east.description: EAST tokamak exceeded the Greenwald density limit in January 2026, achieving plasma densities previously considered theoretically impossible. China maintains global leadership in high-density sustained plasma research under its $1.5B 14th Five-Year Plan fusion program.

timeline.title: Merger Announced
timeline.detail: All-stock deal signed. Boards approved. DJT stock +33% on day of.

timeline.title: $200M Cash to TAE at Signing
timeline.detail: Additional $100M available on SEC Form S-4 filing.

timeline.title: SEC Form S-4 Filed
timeline.detail: TAE Technologies and Trump Media filed Form S-4 registration statement with SEC. Trump retains significant ownership interest in combined entity per regulatory filing disclosures.

timeline.title: Shareholder + Regulatory Close
timeline.detail: SEC S-4 filed September 30, 2026; review ongoing. Truth Social spinoff cancelled; integrated company structure confirmed. Jeff Woodbury appointed TAE President/COO. Trump Jr. joins board. Original mid-2026 close target passed; awaiting SEC approval and shareholder vote. TAE secured strategic Helium-3 supply agreement with Black Moon Energy Corporation.

timeline.title: Plant Site Selection Begins
timeline.detail: Nunes stated site search begins after deal closes.
